name: Tan Wei Long
bio:
Tan Wei Long's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his national service. Assigned to a motor pool, he discovered an aptitude for diagnostics and optimization that quickly translated into informal trackside support for local racing teams. He transitioned to a more formal role after his service, spending several years as a data analyst before moving into strategy. 

Wei Long is known for his meticulous preparation and risk-averse approach. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making, often building complex models to simulate race scenarios. His calm demeanor under pressure allows him to adapt strategies effectively, even when unexpected events disrupt the race. His distinctive ability lies in identifying marginal gains, maximizing performance through small but crucial adjustments.

Despite his successes, Wei Long is a private individual who prefers to work independently. He values precision and thoroughness above all else, sometimes leading to delays as he strives for perfection.

physical.description: He is of average height and build, with a serious and focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on using a specific type of pen for marking strategy charts.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
